description: Sets the weekly or monthly activity report email schedule for an installation and replaces the previous recipient list. Requires the client owner; recipients must be verified members of the client's business. The first report is sent by the scheduled job, not by this call.

expectedRevision.description: The installation revision you last read. The call is rejected if the installation has changed since.

installationId.description: The agency package installation to act on.

recipients.description: User IDs (1-20) of verified business members who should receive the report.

name: agency_report_configure
title: Schedule Activity Report Emails
